messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered PD#892317 — rule=proxy-error-rate-high — us-west-2-prod — https://pagerduty.local/PD892317

oncall-alex: Acked PD#892317. I'm taking this. @sre-jamie can you take a look at proxy/ingress metrics?

sre-jamie: looking now. seeing a short 503 spike window ~15:02-15:04 UTC. pulling logs.

eng-ops-maya: saw canary alerts pop in multiple regions at the same time — partner load-testing kicked off around 15:01 UTC per ops slack. could be correlated.

sre-jamie: quick log excerpt:```
2026-03-17T15:02:10Z proxy-1 ERROR resp=503 path=/v1/generate x-rid=abc123
2026-03-17T15:02:22Z proxy-2 ERROR resp=503 path=/v1/generate x-rid=def456
2026-03-17T15:03:05Z proxy-1 INFO resp=200 path=/v1/generate x-rid=ghi789
```

oncall-alex: noted. no active customer pages so far, but let’s confirm SLOs and customer-facing errors.

incident-bot: PD#892317 auto-resolved (signal returned to baseline).

oncall-alex: Confirmed auto-resolve — baseline restored at ~15:03 UTC. Quick customer-impact check: 99.98% success rate for the 15:00-15:05 window, no user-facing escalations reported.

sre-jamie: appears to be short-lived client-side retry storm from partner traffic surge, not backend degradation. Will open follow-up ticket SRE-321 to add a canary filter and tune threshold. :white_check_mark:

pm-ryan: thanks — can you add a short note for CS and flag if any customers hit transient errors?

oncall-alex: will add a brief blameless note to #incidents and ping CS with the summary. tagging SRE-321 for follow-up.

eng-ops-maya: adding that partner ops confirmed they ran a burst test without advance notice, will coordinate on cadence next time.

sre-jamie: TL;DR: ephemeral PD ping -> acked -> correlated to external burst -> auto-resolved -> create SRE-321 to harden canary filters. No customer impact.

oncall-alex: reacting :thumbsup: to incident-bot and closing this thread.
